blocks.text: In 2001-12-03, Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the platform category, Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
